library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

district_2024 <- read_csv("data/precinct_2024_map_results.csv")
district_ab604 <- read_csv("data/ab604_results.csv")

cd_2024 <- st_read("data/shapefiles/cd_2024/cd_2024.shp")
ab604_map <- st_read("AB604/AB604.shp")


# 1. Seats won
seats_2024 <- district_2024 %>%
  mutate(winner = ifelse(dem > rep, "DEM", "REP")) %>%
  count(winner)

seats_ab604 <- district_ab604 %>%
  mutate(winner = ifelse(dem > rep, "DEM", "REP")) %>%
  count(winner)

# 2. Mean–Median Score
mean_median_2024 <- mean(district_2024$dem_share, na.rm = TRUE) -
                    median(district_2024$dem_share, na.rm = TRUE)

mean_median_ab604 <- mean(district_ab604$dem / district_ab604$total, na.rm = TRUE) -
                     median(district_ab604$dem / district_ab604$total, na.rm = TRUE)

# 3. Efficiency Gap
wasted_votes <- function(vA, vB) {
  total <- vA + vB
  half <- total / 2
  
  if (vA > vB) {
    c(A = vA - half, B = vB)     # A wins → A wastes surplus, B wastes all
  } else {
    c(A = vA, B = vB - half)     # B wins → B wastes surplus, A wastes all
  }
}

# efficiency gap for OLD MAP
eff_gap_2024 <- (sum(district_2024$wasted_rep) - sum(district_2024$wasted_dem)) /
                 sum(district_2024$total)

# efficiency gap for NEW MAP
ab604_waste <- district_ab604 %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    waste = list(wasted_votes(dem, rep)),
    wasted_dem = waste[[1]],
    wasted_rep = waste[[2]]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

eff_gap_ab604 <- (sum(ab604_waste$wasted_rep) - sum(ab604_waste$wasted_dem)) /
                  sum(ab604_waste$total)

comparison_table <- tibble(
  Metric = c("Seats Won (DEM)", "Seats Won (REP)",
             "Mean–Median Score", "Efficiency Gap"),
  `2024 Map` = c(
    seats_2024$n[seats_2024$winner == "DEM"],
    seats_2024$n[seats_2024$winner == "REP"],
    round(mean_median_2024, 4),
    round(eff_gap_2024, 4)
  ),
  `AB604 Map` = c(
    seats_ab604$n[seats_ab604$winner == "DEM"],
    seats_ab604$n[seats_ab604$winner == "REP"],
    round(mean_median_ab604, 4),
    round(eff_gap_ab604, 4)
  )
)

comparison_table


# 2024 district map
cd_2024_plot <- cd_2024 %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(fill = "lightgray", color = "white") +
  ggtitle("California Congressional Districts — 2024 Map") +
  theme_minimal()

cd_2024_plot

# AB604 proposed map
ab604_plot <- ab604_map %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(fill = "lightblue", color = "white") +
  ggtitle("California Congressional Districts — Proposed AB 604 Map") +
  theme_minimal()

ab604_plot

district_2024 %>%
  select(district, dem, rep, total) %>%
  arrange(district)

district_ab604 %>%
  select(district, dem, rep, total, winner, margin) %>%
  arrange(district)
```
